why: Five fixed prompts re-rendered whenever the image model changes, to see if the brand look shifted (docs/brand/ai-image-prompting.md, section 5). Run only on Amir's go: each run costs money.

prompts.subject: One pale rose lying on a dark stone ledge after rain.
An empty Berlin side street at night under a single streetlight, wet cobbles.
A wooden chair in an empty room, a sheet of window light across the floor.
A full moon over a still lake.
Worn paper with faint water stains and dust.
